scope: All retained registered attempt IDs at this cutoff, not independent product executions. Parent commands, setup, calibration, intentional failures, retries and collection are included; no failed category is converted to a pass.
limits: Initial unregistered commands remain excluded as documented. Frozen epoch-one damage is preserved and only the exact quarantined fragment is excluded by the shared reader. Category totals do not imply accepted scenario or final repetition counts.
